name: The Highland Vertical
challenge: Operating in Norway's extreme latitude meant severe seasonal light deprivation for up to 20 hours a day in winter. Manual monitoring across 18 vertical growing levels was unsustainable, leading to inconsistent crop cycles, undetected pest outbreaks, and 35% higher water waste than industry benchmarks.
solution: HariLeaf deployed the full LeafSense AI Vision stack across every tier of the facility, enabling real-time anomaly detection at 98% accuracy. HydroLogic Hub automated sub-surface irrigation using live soil moisture telemetry and predictive weather modeling, while AeroFleet drones conducted weekly structural and canopy surveys.
farmerQuote: HariLeaf transformed how we grow. We now have complete visibility into every plant on every level, every single day — without ever setting foot on the floor.
farmerRole: Head of Operations, The Highland Vertical
